canonical_data_rule: Canonical data remains the source of truth. This batch records evidence candidates and does not infer unsupported acquisition/UF semantics.

records.name: Ki Explosion

records.promotion: Charge/damage figures are test-contextual; do not promote as universal scaling without stronger provenance.

records.name: Kamekameha

records.promotion: Identity/cost/user evidence is stronger than the damage figure; retain test-context qualifier.
